rail.help: Stuck? The install guide covers every check on this list.

welcome.title: Let's get your community online
welcome.subtitle: {{count}} short steps, about five minutes. We'll check your server, connect your database and write the config for you — nothing touches disk until you say go.

noconfig.title: No config files
noconfig.desc: We generate every secret and write .env for you.

retry.title: Safe to retry
retry.desc: Wrong credentials? Nothing is saved until a check passes.

locks.title: Locks itself after
locks.desc: Once you're done the wizard bolts the door behind it.

norestart.title: No restart
norestart.desc: The full app boots in place the moment config lands.

welcome.docker_hint: Running the bundled Docker infra? Keep your terminal open — the database step can fill itself in with its defaults.

environment.title: Checking your server
environment.subtitle: A few quick probes for the things Xentium needs to run. This is read-only.
environment.block_reason: Fix the failing checks to continue

summary.ready: Your server is ready for Xentium.
summary.fix: Fix the red rows, then re-check.

database.title: Connect your database
database.setup_subtitle: We test as you type. When it goes green, we'll generate your secrets, write the config and create the schema.
database.configured_subtitle: Your server already carries a DATABASE_URL. We only need to check that it answers.
database.swap_wait: Writing the config and starting the server…
database.setup_failed: The server did not come back up in time. Check the server logs and try again.
database.env_preview_sub: Four secrets, generated on the server. Nothing is written until you continue.

site.title: Make it yours
site.subtitle: Names, dates and a language. All of it is editable later in the admin panel.
site.url_hint: The full URL where your site will be reachable.
site.timezone_hint: Used for displaying dates and times across the platform.

addons.title: Add what you need
addons.label: Add-ons
addons.subtitle: Xentium works on its own. Everything here is optional, and nothing is permanent — add or remove any of it later from the admin panel.
addons.account_sub: Link one to install add-ons — every download goes through your account, free or paid.
addons.skipped: Free add-ons only for now. You can link an account any time from the admin panel.
addons.link_pending_sub: We opened the approval page in a new tab. Check that it shows this code, then approve it there.
addons.link_failed: Couldn't reach the marketplace. You can link an account later from the admin panel.
addons.link_expired: That link request expired. Start a new one.
addons.unreachable: We couldn't reach the marketplace, so there's nothing to add here. That's fine — the install carries on, and you can add plugins later from the admin panel.
addons.locked_licence: Unlocks with an account that owns it.
addons.tally_one: 1 add-on queued — it installs right after your account is created.
addons.tally_other: {{count}} add-ons queued — they install right after your account is created.
addons.tally_empty: Nothing selected — a bare Xentium works fine, and you can add these later.
addons.tally_unlinked: Link a marketplace account above to pick add-ons — or skip this step and add them later.

admin.title: Your account
admin.subtitle: This is the first administrator — full run of the place. Pick a password you'd trust with it.
admin.generated: Generated — copy it somewhere safe before continuing.
admin.pw_advice: Longer beats clever. A passphrase is fine.

finalize.title: Ready when you are
finalize.subtitle: One last look. Hitting install creates your account, fetches the add-ons you picked and locks the installer behind you.

log.admin: administrator {{username}} created · added to the admin group
log.addon_installed_only: {{name}} {{version}} installed — enable it from the admin panel

done.title: You're live
done.subtitle: {{site}} is installed and running. You're signed in as administrator, and the installer has locked itself behind you.
done.tip: First thing worth doing: set up outbound email so verification and notification messages can actually leave the server.

toast.env_fail: Every check has to pass before we continue.
toast.db_fail: We need a working database connection first.
toast.admin_invalid_email: That email address doesn't look right.
toast.admin_invalid_username: Usernames are 3–32 letters, numbers or underscores.
toast.admin_invalid_password: Give your password at least 12 characters.
toast.admin_password_mismatch: The two passwords don't match yet.
toast.api_unreachable: Could not reach the API server. Make sure it is running.
